subject: Cygnus Health — Closed-network deployment questionnaire and integration workback
messages:
From: Linda Ng <linda.ng@cygnushealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodai.com
Cc: security@cygnushealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Cygnus closed-network deployment questionnaire (initial)

Jonas —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Attached is our closed-network deployment questionnaire (we abbreviated it to the key controls) — we need detailed answers and any evidence you can provide by EOD Friday so our security team can complete the vendor assessment. Key items we expect covered: airgap/egress controls, operator access model, patching and SW supply chain, KMS/HSM integration, and offline patching/rollback procedures.

A couple of clarifying notes up front:
- We will require an installer that can be executed from an isolated admin workstation (no internet).
- Our preference is to host the control plane in our VPC with no outbound egress except to our internal registry.
- We will ask for a runbook excerpt showing emergency rollback.

I've attached the questionnaire (cygnus_closed_network_questionnaire.xlsx). If there's a standard evidence pack you already provide for closed-network installs, please include it. Also include an expected timeline for a 3-node pilot in our primary datacenter.

Best,
Linda
Director, Vendor Security
Cygnus Health

Attachments: cygnus_closed_network_questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: jonas.weber@redwoodai.com <jonas_weber@redwoodai.com>
To: Linda Ng <linda.ng@cygnushealth.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwoodai.com, marissa.cole@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cygnus closed-network deployment questionnaire (initial)

Linda —

Thanks for the questionnaire and the clear priorities. Attaching an initial response set today and we will follow up with deeper evidence by Friday. High-level notes here to set expectations: 

1) Installer & airgap: We provide an airgapped installer bundle (tarball + checksums + signed manifests) that can be copied into your isolated admin workstation. The install runs entirely offline; we include an offline dependency bundle you host on a local registry.

2) Control plane placement: We support both customer-hosted control plane (VPC) and our managed control plane. For your requirement (no outbound egress), customer-hosted control plane is the recommended path — our operator manifest supports private-only endpoints and HA via internal load balancers.

3) Operator access & RBAC: We support operator credentials via customer-managed KMS/HSM and an operator short-lived key workflow; operators authenticate against an LDAP/AD endpoint in your VPC (we ship an authentication adaptor).

4) Patching & rollback: Offline patch bundles plus a staged canary process. Rollback uses image immutability and a documented emergency rollback playbook (excerpt attached).

We are compiling: installer guide, runbook excerpt, signed SBOMs, and a sample network diagram. I’m looping Priyom and Marissa for technical evidence and timeline. Expect the evidence pack (redwood_offline_install_guide.pdf, operator_runbook_excerpt.md) in a follow-up reply by Thursday close of business.

Proposed pilot workback (high level): 2–3 week prep (access, network, local registry seed) + 3–5 day install and validation window for 3-node pilot. We can tighten once we see your maintenance window constraints.

Next steps: confirm your preferred control plane option (customer-hosted VPC) and a date window for a kickoff.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: cygnus_closed_network_questionnaire_responses_summary.pdf (will follow)

From: Linda Ng <linda.ng@cygnushealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodai.com
Cc: security@cygnushealth.com
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cygnus closed-network deployment questionnaire (initial)

Jonas —

Appreciate the quick summary. Two clarifying questions from our security team after a brief review: 

1) KMS/HSM: Can you confirm whether the operator short-lived key workflow supports an external HSM (PKCS#11) in our VPC, and whether keys ever transit Redwood-managed services? We need explicit confirmation of no key material leaving our HSM.

2) Supply chain / SBOM: For offline bundles, do you provide SBOMs and signed manifests for every component, and can you provide a dated attestations log for the last two quarterly releases?

If you can answer those two items and include the requested runbook excerpt and installer checksums, we should be able to clear the questionnaire.

Regards,
Linda

On Thu, May 21, 2028 at 09:14 AM Linda Ng <linda.ng@cygnushealth.com> wrote:
> Jonas —
> > [original message quoted above]

From: jonas.weber@redwoodai.com <jonas_weber@redwoodai.com>
To: Linda Ng <linda.ng@cygnushealth.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwoodai.com, marissa.cole@redwoodai.com
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cygnus closed-network deployment questionnaire (initial) — evidence pack and confirmations

Linda —

Thanks — answering inline below and attaching the requested evidence pack.

1) KMS/HSM: Confirmed. Our operator short-lived key flow fully supports customer-managed HSMs that implement PKCS#11. Keys are generated and retained in your HSM; Redwood never receives raw key material. Our adaptor performs local signing operations via PKCS#11 calls against the HSM in your VPC. We have a short technical note in the pack describing the adaptor handshake and trust model (no key material egress).

2) SBOM & attestations: We provide SBOMs (CycloneDX) and signed manifests for every offline bundle. Attached is an attestations log for the last three quarterly releases (signed timestamps) and a sample CycloneDX SBOM linked to the 2028-04 offline bundle.

Attachments included in this reply (zipped evidence bundle delivered via Drive link):
- redwood_offline_install_guide.pdf — installer steps, checksums, manifest verification, seed registry instructions
- operator_runbook_excerpt.md — emergency rollback steps, operator escalation procedures
- redwood_sbom_202804.cdx.json.sig — signed SBOM manifest (signature stub)
- attestations_q1-q3_2028.pdf — signed release attestation log

Pilot timeline (finalized):
- Week 0: contractual & network prep, KMS access arrangements (2 business days to provision access for integrator)
- Week 1: seed registry and offline bundle delivery (we deliver bundles on encrypted media or via your S3 endpoint)
- Week 2: install + smoke tests (3 node cluster)
- Week 3: validation & handoff (operator walkthrough + knowledge transfer)

Action items: 
- Linda: confirm preferred day for kickoff (we have availability starting 2028-06-05).
- Cygnus security: confirm they received the Drive link and can access the signed artifacts (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCYGNUS-RFP-DRIVE).

If anything else is needed for procurement (sample MSA clause for control plane placement or an elevated SLA for pilot), loop Marissa and Priyom and we’ll include.

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_offline_install_guide.pdf (application/pdf), operator_runbook_excerpt.md (text/markdown), redwood_sbom_202804.cdx.json.sig (application/octet-stream), attestations_q1-q3_2028.pdf (application/pdf)
